issue_context.title: Add caching of RBAC claims retrieved via LDAP
issue_context.body: Following up to https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/12938. The claims are currently retrieved on every request. These claims should be persisted via a cache.

review_comments: This is different from the certificate validation cache in that it's not stored in DI. It might be a bit odd to have the cache in LdapSettings but I'm not sure if there's any value in putting this cache in DI.
Main value of putting it in DI is if you want to make it easy for them to plug in their own cache implementation
While that's true, I'm not sure we'd want that kind of flexibility here at the moment. I don't see it as particularly useful in this scenario.
That's fine, I was just pointing out what advantages putting it in DI has
As I expected, this is really hacky but it works.
